intended_object: The canonical isomorphism of K-schemes between the r-th stage U_r of the unitriangular group scheme (entries a_ij with 0<j−i<r set to zero) and affine space A^{SurvivingPair n r}_K on the surviving entries (i+r ≤ j). Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body applies Spec to the K-algebra isomorphism polynomialEquiv : CoordinateRing K n r ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (SurvivingPair n r) K. It composes this with the inverse of Mathlib's AffineSpace.SpecIso and checks compatibility with the structure maps to Spec K (via AffineSpace.SpecIso_inv_over and the fact that polynomialEquiv commutes with algebraMap), producing an isomorphism in Over (Spec K). CoordinateRing K n r is the unitriangular coordinate ring modulo the entries with j < i + r. SurvivingPair n r is the set of strict upper pairs with i + r ≤ j. So this is exactly the statement that U_r is affine space on its surviving coordinates, matching the docstring, which also notes that the iso is not claimed to respect the additive group structure. K is an arbitrary commutative ring, the natural base. Fin n is needed because the stage condition compares index positions numerically. Mathlib has no unitriangular stage group schemes, so there is no more general version it should have used.
